description: Wick Brood reinforcement on the wave6 v0 formula (flat ground, three-quarter, fused amber gourds — the only clean approval). Eliminated: driftwood/climbing (grew gripping limbs), front-on framing (grew chassis legs), floating-orb eyes. New pose ids (records are keyed by id), fresh seeds.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink creature concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, one warm tallow light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture

defaults.negative: anime, manga, cartoon, cel shading, chibi, cute, photograph, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth CG, human person, human face, modern gear, metal plate armor, gun, text, watermark, frame, border, signature, lantern, lamp, separate creatures standing apart, a group of distinct monsters, companions, insects, bees, flies, ants, beetles, spider, spider legs, insect legs, arms, hands, legs, claws, tree roots, root legs, floating orbs, floating lights, slime mascot, googly eyes, slit pupil, cat eye, smiling face, carved face, lit candle, candlestick, flame, spiderweb, cobweb, tentacles

subjects.prompt: a Wick Brood, one low clotted heap of fist-sized soft rounded amber tallow bodies all fused together at their flanks into a single flat mass, bound in a net of dark wet peat-flesh strands, each rounded body tipped with a small charred black stub, small dull round amber spots set into the leading bodies, slow amber drips setting along its edges, resting directly on flat wet peat at a three-quarter angle, colours peat black-brown, bog green, tallow gold, pale misty background

a Wick Brood dragging itself slowly across flat wet peat as one single fused clot of rounded amber tallow bodies, a wide smeared trail of half-set amber tallow stretching behind it on the ground, charred black stubs tipping each fused body, dark peat-flesh strands binding the mass into one piece, three small dull round amber spots low on the leading edge, colours peat black-brown, bog green, tallow gold, dark misty background

a Wick Brood half-sunk in shallow still black bog water, one single fused flat heap of soft rounded amber tallow bodies joined at the flanks, the lower bodies darkened with soaked wet peat, charred black stubs on every rounded body, half-set amber tallow strands webbing the mass together, faint dull amber spots glowing on the bodies above the waterline, colours peat black-brown, bog green, tallow gold, pale misty background

a Wick Brood from its broad side at a low angle, one wide flat sagging clot of fused rounded amber tallow bodies sitting as a single connected mass on dark wet peat among sparse dead reeds, short stubby tendrils of half-set tallow trailing from its rear edge onto the ground, charred black stubs tipping the bodies, three small dull round amber spots in a shallow arc near the front of the mass, colours peat black-brown, bog green, tallow gold, dark misty background
